title: Retention policy (LH-PERSIST-006)
description: Per-data-class retention durations. Each entry is optional: an absent field means 'retain forever' for that class. The audit class follows LH-PERSIST-006: it has no default retention; deletion is only enabled by an explicit operator_audit_retention entry.

duration.description: C# TimeSpan format: 'D.HH:MM:SS' (with optional days prefix and optional fractional seconds). 'P30D' / ISO-8601 forms are intentionally not supported in M1 to keep the parser predictable.
